arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Goldstein argued the Secretary defined outside salesmen as those who make sales.
Mr. Clement stated the sides that brought the case were hired and evaluated as salespeople.
Mr. Stewart noted common ground that outside salesmen must make sales.
Justice Alito questioned the consistency of the government's title transfer argument.
